findings.conclusion: Company GP2026 page explicitly states original-product ratio40%以上 and LV2030 page55%以上 as goals. They are not author-owned forecasts, thresholds, reached results or EPS coefficients.

GP describes combining company, group and co-creation partner manufacturing functions and direct-sales×manufacturing inside the company. This is a description of the business model, not a numerator inclusion rule for all partner products or group direct sales.

LV explicitly discusses overseas exclusively sellable products and own-product development. This adds company-primary qualitative context to the old author p6/7 overseas examples, but does not reconcile p44domestic-partner language into a single statistical definition.

No explicit three-category original-product computation list or correspondence to brand/PB was identified in these two visible HTML bodies. This is not a claim of non-disclosure in other documents or images.

Consolidated revenue targets appear in plan context, but a formula for historical29.3% or a ratio-specific consolidated/standalone boundary, external sales, elimination or group-direct-sales treatment is not established. Same40/55numbers do not prove same definitions.

Plan labels GP2026/LV2030 are visible. Exact fiscal end dates, measurement/reclassification history and plan publication/update timestamps were not established in extracted HTML. Old author27/3 and31/3attribution is retained as prior external evidence, not promoted to new HTML period verification.
